quote: HIDDEN_ROW (company-level row trim: Altria reports no total share-based compensation in any year - no CF line, no undimensioned fact; coverage 2026-11-15 marks sbc 2015-2025 HIDDEN_ROW). FY2016 Stock Plans note: "Altria Group, Inc. recorded pre-tax compensation expense related to restricted stock and restricted stock units granted to employees for the years ended December 31, 2016, 2015 and 2014 of $44 million, $51 million and $46 million, respectively." That figure covers employee RS/RSU only (instance: AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense[AwardTypeAxis=RestrictedAndDeferredStockMember] 2015 = 51000000); Directors Plan stock awards are not quantified, so it is not a proven company total.
rule_proposal: sbc_award_type_sum (later, row-wide): sbc = sum of AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense over the AwardTypeAxis members when no undimensioned total exists, accepted only when the note shows the members cover all plans; MO 2015/2016 fail that test (Directors Plan unquantified), so hide
